resources.string: When the app crashes or hits an error, it sends a report to the app developer: where in the app it happened, the app and system version, recent log lines and a random ID of this installation. Never messages, names, file names or keys.

When the app crashes or hits an error, it sends a report to your organization\'s crash reports service: where in the app it happened, the app and system version, recent log lines and a random ID of this installation. Never messages, names, file names or keys.

Your organization requires crash reports. They go to the app developer and say where in the app a crash happened, the app and system version, recent log lines and a random ID of this installation. Never messages, names, file names or keys.
